data.description:
## Description

What: Create plugins/dso/scripts/runner-touch-check.sh wired as a .pre-commit-config.yaml entry that runs the identical equivalence script and hard-blocks the commit on any divergence. Derive its path filter from the manifest and include each engine's shared-library dependencies (e.g., tests/lib/) so a shared-lib change cannot bypass the gate. A manifest-declared harness whose path is missing or renamed must make the test FAIL LOUDLY (not silently skip). Activate the hard block only after the draft-5 zero-divergence baseline exists. Why: sc-4 is the enforcement that catches drift at authoring time, closing the reactive-post-merge gap. Scope IN: runner-touch-check.sh, the manifest-derived path filter including shared-lib deps, the loud-failure-on-missing/renamed-path behavior, and the .pre-commit-config.yaml wiring. Scope OUT: the equivalence test internals (draft-3/draft-4); the baseline audit (draft-5).

## Done Definitions

- Staging a divergence-introducing harness edit causes runner-touch-check.sh to hard-block the commit ← Satisfies: sc-4
- The hook's path filter is derived from the manifest and includes each engine's shared-library dependencies so a tests/lib/ change triggers the gate ← Satisfies: sc-4
- A manifest-declared harness whose path is missing or renamed makes the check FAIL LOUDLY rather than silently skip ← Satisfies: sc-4
- An integration test exercises the pre-commit hook in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no pre-existing worktrees, no global git config, no environment variables pre-set from the developer's machine) and the hook blocks a staged divergence ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations

- [Boundary] plugins/dso/scripts/runner-touch-check.sh must be added to the plugin-boundary allowlist; set the executable bit on it.
- [Sequencing] Wire the hard block only after the draft-5 zero-divergence baseline exists.
- [Coverage] Including shared-lib paths (tests/lib/) is load-bearing.
- [Residual-References] The manifest-derived path filter must stay in sync with each engine's actual tests/lib/ source dependencies. Add a check that FAILS LOUDLY when an engine sources a tests/lib/ file that is not represented in the manifest path filter, so the filter cannot silently rot into under-coverage as engines gain or change shared-library dependencies.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a developer, I want a pre-commit hook that runs the identical equivalence script and hard-blocks commits on divergence, so that engine drift cannot be merged once the baseline exists.
